english: A sector $OAB$ of a circle with centre $O$ has arc $AB$ of length $6\pi$ cm and area $54\pi$ cm$^2$. A circle $\Gamma$ lies inside the sector and touches the radii $OA$, $OB$ and the arc $AB$. If the area of the part of the sector lying outside $\Gamma$ is $k\pi$ cm$^2$, then the value of $k$ is ______.
hindi: केन्द्र $O$ वाले एक वृत्त के त्रिज्यखण्ड $OAB$ के चाप $AB$ की लम्बाई $6\pi$ cm तथा क्षेत्रफल $54\pi$ cm$^2$ है। एक वृत्त $\Gamma$ त्रिज्यखण्ड के अन्दर स्थित है तथा त्रिज्याओं $OA$, $OB$ और चाप $AB$ को स्पर्श करता है। यदि त्रिज्यखण्ड के उस भाग का क्षेत्रफल, जो $\Gamma$ के बाहर है, $k\pi$ cm$^2$ है, तो $k$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Area $=\dfrac12 r\ell\Rightarrow 54\pi=\dfrac12 r(6\pi)\Rightarrow r=18$; angle $\theta=\dfrac{\ell}{r}=\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ radian $=60^\circ$
Centre $P$ of $\Gamma$ (radius $\rho$) is on the bisector: $OP=\dfrac{\rho}{\sin 30^\circ}=2\rho$; touching the arc: $OP+\rho=18\Rightarrow\rho=6$
solution_full: For a sector of radius $r$ and arc length $\ell$, the area is $\dfrac12 r\ell$ (since area $=\dfrac12 r^2\theta$ and $\ell=r\theta$, with $\theta$ in radians).
So $54\pi=\dfrac12\cdot r\cdot 6\pi$, which gives $r=18$ cm. The central angle is $\theta=\dfrac{\ell}{r}=\dfrac{6\pi}{18}=\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ radian, that is $60^\circ$.

A circle touching both radii has its centre $P$ on the bisector of $\angle AOB$, which makes $30^\circ$ with each radius. If $\rho$ is its radius, the distance from $P$ to $OA$ is $OP\sin 30^\circ=\rho$, so $OP=2\rho$.
Touching the arc internally means $OP+\rho=r$: $3\rho=18$, so $\rho=6$ cm. Area of $\Gamma$ $=36\pi$ cm$^2$.
Area of the sector outside $\Gamma$ $=54\pi-36\pi=18\pi$ cm$^2$, so $k=18$.
originality_note: New: the sector is fixed only through its arc length and area, so radius and radian measure must be recovered first; then the circle inscribed in the sector is located by the 30 degree bisector (way 5). Closest known: ratio of incircle to sector for a 60 degree sector. Different because: the angle is not given; it comes from l = r theta after r = 2A/l.
blueprint_concepts: Measurement of angles: degree, radian, arc length and sector area

concept_use.Measurement of angles: degree, radian, a: Area = (1/2) r l gives r = 18, theta = l/r = pi/3 radian = 60 degrees, and the sector area 54 pi is used in the final subtraction.
